searchText: Hello everyone! On ACDE #227 we decided to move the EIP-7745 trustless log index discussion to its own breakout session which I am now trying to find a suitable time slot for. My initial suggestion for the first session would be Tuesday, 20th Jan 14:00 UTC, held bi-weekly (we can change the frequency later as required). Does this sound good to those who might be interested? hey i have meeting on odd weeks with <@881905303011086387> if its on even weeks its fine 20th jan is even week if i'm not mistaken so it should be good for you then? Mikhail earmarked this time for the fast confirmation rule break-out on yesterday's call. Overlap seems small, but just flagging. yeah yeah seems fine i was gonna reach out on dms anyway 🤣 Thanks for the notification. The overlap is indeed small (probably none) though because FCR is a consensus thing while the log index is purely EL, so I think I'll just go ahead and schedule it if there is no objection 🙂 While Tuesday seems to me like the best choice in general, I am perfectly fine with doing it sooner or later, I just chose 14h UTC because it seems to be the default choice that's more or less acceptable for all continents. https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/1869
